parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, typically rectangular and attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open or close the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box that supports the shelves and door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and support for the door and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, rectangular and fitted inside the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable within the frame.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, providing a central storage surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed in the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable depending on the cabinet design.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, forming the top internal storage surface.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for lighter or less frequently accessed items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable within the cabinet frame.
